about: shas only (no game data): the inputs the core tests need. 'file' = sha256 of the file; 'tree' = smoke.py tree_sha (path + content sha of every file); 'listing' = sha256 of every file's path and size (stat only, for big folders). smoke_set: its inputs are checked by 'smoke.py check'. Rewritten only inside a round commit (release.py fixtures --write).
